## Fixed

- **Themed icons stay on.** Every time the home screen started again, which a wallpaper changer causes on each lock, the launcher looked for a themed icon pack, found none and switched themed icons off. The same happened whenever any app was uninstalled. That check is gone, so themed icons stay on until you turn them off.
- **App drawer folders pick up themed icons straight away.** Folders in the app drawer kept their old icons after a change until they were scrolled off the screen and back. They are now redrawn as soon as their apps or icons change, which also covers renaming a folder or changing what is in it.
